title: 第15章 我来讲故事顺便杀人第16章 秀才不教书秀才杀人
content_zh:
“别等了，勾栏起火，来不了。”
来人走路肩膀时高时低，进了院门，灯火一照，原来是个瘸子。
“陆天明？”有一巡卒奇怪道。
当啷——！
陆天明来的时候，从前庭顺了把椅子。
放下椅子后，他反手把院门一关。
大马金刀坐在门前。
面对一百多号人，脸上却平静得像一汪深潭。
“陆天明，你什么意思？”
等不来女人，周世豪本来就火大。
陆天明莫名其妙搞这么一出，犹如火上浇油。
“字面意思。”
陆天明指向烟柳巷的方向。
所有做皮肉生意的苦命人，都在那里。
众人顺着他指的方向看去。
才见火光四射，烈火把夜空照得宛如白昼。
“你放的火？”周世豪眯眼道。
“不错，我怕她们耽误事。”陆天明理了理衣摆。
今天，他特意穿了一件灰色长袍。
十八岁生日刘大宝送他的。

很贵，一直没舍得穿。
“哈哈，哈哈哈。”
人愤怒到极点的时候，会做出一些奇怪的举动。
此刻的周世豪就是。
他一手遥指陆天明，一手捂着肚子大笑。
“兄弟们，我知道这小子是来干什么的了。”
笑声感染力很强，众人也跟着发笑。
他们都看出来了。
“大人，这小子不会是来给那死人报仇的吧？”有人扶着墙，笑得直不起腰。
“你瞅他云淡风轻的模样，可不就是整那扮猪吃虎的死出？”有人抹着眼睛，笑得眼泪直流。
陆天明不为所动，平静道：“刘大宝，还没死。”
“你看，他还较真，可不就是离死不远吗？”
“周大人有大量，不跟他计较，怎滴，你嫌他死得不够透，过来催我们上门啊？”
面对嘲讽，陆天明仍然保持冷静。
“我知道的，开业之前不能见血光，我不来，过了今夜，你们也会去找他。”
周世豪止住笑。
不是因为陆天明看透了他的想法。
而是跟一个瘸子纠缠，实在没什么意思。
content_en:
"Don't wait, the hook bar is on fire and we can't come."
The visitor's shoulders were raised and lowered as he walked. When he entered the courtyard gate, the light shone and it turned out that he was a lame man.
"Lu Tianming?" a patrol soldier asked curiously.
Dang Cang——!
When Lu Tianming arrived, he took a chair from the vestibule.
After putting down the chair, he closed the courtyard door with his backhand.
Da Ma Jin Dao sat in front of the door.
Facing more than a hundred people, his face was as calm as a deep pool.
"Lu Tianming, what do you mean?"
Zhou Shihao was already very angry because he couldn't wait for a woman.
Lu Tianming did this out of nowhere, which was like adding fuel to the fire.
"Literally."
Lu Tianming pointed in the direction of Yanliu Lane.
All the miserable people in the flesh business are there.
Everyone looked in the direction he pointed.
Then I saw the fire radiating everywhere, and the fierce fire lit up the night sky like day.
"Did you set the fire?" Zhou Shihao narrowed his eyes.
"Yes, I'm afraid they will delay things." Lu Tianming straightened his clothes.
Today, he wore a gray robe.
Liu Dabao gave it to him on his eighteenth birthday.
It’s very expensive and I’ve never been willing to wear it.
"Haha, hahaha."
When people are extremely angry, they will do some strange things.
This is Zhou Shihao at this moment.
He pointed at Lu Tianming with one hand and laughed while covering his stomach with the other.
"Brothers, I know what this kid is here to do."
The laughter was so contagious that everyone laughed too.
They all saw it.
"Sir, is this kid here to avenge the dead man?" Someone was holding on to the wall, laughing so hard that he couldn't stand up straight.
"Looking at his calm and calm appearance, isn't it just like that guy who pretends to be a pig and eats the tiger?" Someone wiped his eyes and laughed until tears flowed down his face.
Lu Tianming remained unmoved and said calmly: "Liu Dabao is not dead yet."
"Look, he is quite serious, but isn't he just close to death?"
"Master Zhou has a lot of people, so don't care about him. Why, you think he didn't die enough, so why don't you come here and urge us to come?"
In the face of ridicule, Lu Tianming remained calm.
"I know, there can't be any blood before the business opens. If I don't come, you will go find him after tonight."
Zhou Shihao stopped laughing.
It wasn't because Lu Tianming saw through his thoughts.
But it's really not interesting to tangle with a cripple.
